newsitem.title: USA: Tower Air Oct total block hours down.
newsitem.headline: Tower Air Oct total block hours down.

text.p: Tower Air Inc said today that it had a 40.6% decrease in total block hours flown in October 1996 to 2,449 hours compared to the year ago figure of 4,126 hours.
For the ten month period ended October 31, 1996, total block hours flown decreased 6.8% to 37,021 hours from 39,725 hours during the same period in 1995.

The decreases in total block hours flown in October 1996, when compared to the same period in 1995, were primarily because of reductions in military and commercial charter activity and the withdrawal from the India market, said the company in a release dated November 6.

The company also said that scheduled passenger service available seat miles in October 1996 decreased 25.5% to 313 million from 420 million in October 1995. For the ten-month period ended Oct. 31, 1996, ASMs increased 2.4% to 4,093 million from 3,999 million in the comparable 1995 period.
